newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie August same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie August same store sales rise.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday that same store sales for the four weeks to August 31, 1996 rose 3.2 percent from the comparable period last year.
Total sales in August increased six percent to $73 million from $68.8 million last year.
For the year-to-date, Carson Pirie Scott said same store sales were up 2.2 percent. Total sales advanced four percent to $534.7 million from $513.9 million last year.

Stanton Bluestone, chairman and chief executive officer of Carson Pirie Scott, said August sales were driven by double digit increases in special sizes and better sportswear, coats, men's sportswear and furniture.
Carson Pirie Scott operates 52 department stores and three furniture stores.
